statement: The received block-GLS construction uses ten quadratic encoder features, a positive matrix envelope, finite log-determinant updates and actual local matrix queries to obtain expected full-CPTP relative loss with O_tilde(k^5/(gamma epsilon)) source calls and O_tilde(k^2) homogeneous banks.
